requirements.quote:
While the implementor is free to violate these
conventions WITHIN HIS OWN SYSTEM, he must observe these conventions in
ALL behavior observed from other hosts.
requirements.required_behavior: Observe the domain system conventions in all behavior observable by other hosts.
requirements.why_checkable: The clause defines an external-observability scope, but the concrete conventions are absent from this chunk, so it does not independently support an implementation check.

requirements.quote:
While the implementor is free to violate these
conventions WITHIN HIS OWN SYSTEM, he must observe these conventions in
ALL behavior observed from other hosts.
requirements.condition: Behavior confined within the implementor's own system.
requirements.required_behavior: Internal deviations from the domain system conventions are permitted; such deviations are not required.
requirements.why_checkable: The clause permits internal deviations, but this chunk does not specify the conventions or concrete internal behavior to which a check could be applied.
